profile.headline: Principle Software Engineer
profile.summary: More than 35 years of software development experience with strong analytical skills and a very broad range of technical abilities.  An excellent problem solver on any OS with the background to prove it.  An effective team leader, skilled in establishing strong relationships and supporting software engineers.  Excellent project management skills with a proven record of successful products delivered into the field and a strong focus on customers. Software engineer and software development manager with 25+ years of industry experience on Windows, Linux and OS/X.  Experience with C/C++/Java/Python languages.  GPU and graphics expert with experience on Intel Broadwell and Skylake GPUs.  Experienced kernel driver and user mode driver experience in Windows.  Extensive experience with GPU technology including IOMMU, DMA, graphics operations, interrupt handlers, and graphics performance.  Many years of experience performance tuning graphics applications.  In depth understanding of games and how they use the GPU.  OpenGL and DirectX development experience.  Many years developing on Linux in C language.  Android SDK development for the past several months.  DirectX12 game engine development.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Implement machine learning data capture framework.  Capture data and train network; build inference engine.  Take course work  in reinforcement learning and machine learning while working on Masters in Computer Science.  Computer vision and object detection algorithms.  C/C++/C# and python programming with scikit, numpy.

positions.title: Software Development Manager
positions.description: Design and implement WDDM 2.1 kernel and user mode driver for Broadwell and Skylake processors.  Design and implement GPU accelerated drivers in guest OS.  Manage software development in C/C++ language and PowerShell for Windows Server 2016.  Jira project tracking.  Design and develop source code control system in code collaborator.  Interview engineers for software development.  Perform management duties like one-on-ones, team meeting, focal reviews, team discussions and presentations.  Collaborate with other managers on bug fixes for Intel processors in Windows 10 and Windows Server 2016.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Work with vGPU team to design and implement UMA for virtual GPU. Perform project management tasks for team using wiki's, Gantt charts and agile methodologies. Implement python language code to manage build systems. Implement C/C++ complex kernel paging logic for graphics and video driver.  Implement C language multi-monitor logic, DirectX9, GDI, and DirectDraw for Windows.  Implement C language IOAccelerator user mode and kernel mode driver for OSX guest.  Implement C language DXVA driver for Windows guest and host video decode process using Intel's LibVA.  This included parsing H.264E headers and playing video in Linux Qt application.  Work with team to implement DirectX11 backend renderer.  Technical lead on automation test project.  Work with SCons, Python and make build subsystem.  Use perforce, git source code control.  Reduce bug count in maintenance driver from 500 bugs to under 10 bugs over 1.5 years.

positions.title: Develop OpenGL Driver
positions.description: Design and implement kernel software for OS X OpenGL driver for the I965 integrated GPU.   Implement the OS X OpenGL driver architecture in the user mode driver and work with other engineers to make the driver functional and fast.  CVS and make build subsystem.

positions.title: Software Manager/MTS
positions.description:
Develop Embedded Software and Manage Software Team
Write IPL, O/S boot code, drivers, and applications to embedded software projects.  Write boot code, interrupts handlers, DMA software, and drivers for QNX and Win CE 5.0.  Manage several junior software engineers on various embedded platform projects based on the SH2/SH3/SH4 processor.  Manage international development team.

positions.title: Windows OpenGL/Display Driver Software Engineer
positions.description: OpenGL driver engineer.  Design and implement multi-threaded portion of OpenGL driver using TLS for hardware context.  Implement multi-desktop, multi-window software in OpenGL ICD.  NT, W2K, Win XP OpenGL development work including display driver ICD development.  Implement mini-port software for OpenGL driver that allowed client-side DMA buffers.  Texture management optimizations in the OpenGL driver.  ICD tuning and bug fixing.  D3D driver design and development.

positions.title: Software Development Manager
positions.description:
Design and implement chipset specific software for C11/MCP1, C11/MCP2 and C17/MCP2.  Debug emulation software and hardware to boot Win XP and assist with DCT/HCT testing.  Work on Award SBIOS core for C17/MCP2 bring up.  Debug using Phoenix debugger and AMD HDT software.
	
	Professional experience; Manager of Win 9x Display Driver and DirectX Team
Manage display driver software team with 15 engineers.  Interview and hire new display driver engineers.  Schedule projects for production release.  Put together Microsoft project schedules to define product deliveries.  Interface with QA to complete HCT testing.  Interface with marketing and sales on production requirements.  Work together with Diamond management team to produce DirectX drivers.
Research, design and develop 3D products.  This work included reading chip specifications, interacting with chip companies at the marketing and technical levels, and, finally, selecting chips for Diamond products.  Engineering lead on EDGE 3D and Monster 3D products for Diamond.  Implement D3D drivers for Stealth 3D product (ViRGE chipset).  Performance tune Monster 3D D3D driver with other engineers on the production software team.

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff/Manager of MAC Driver Team
positions.description:
Interface with PowerPC development team. Implement fast OpenGL for MAC platform by writing PowerPC assembly language for lighting, transformations, and clipping.  Produce optimized PowerPC triangle scan converter for QD 3D that produced 30K texture mapped triangles per second.  Develop MAC QD drivers for Wietek 9002 PCI graphics board.  Interface with MAC developers on PowerPC.  Give internal talks on PowerPC to other engineers.
Manage PowerPC transition driver team.  Manage all aspects of projects including schedules, hiring, driver development, applet development and communications with other groups in Apple.  Perform business development on 3D graphics in the PC industry.  Review technical specifications for Surfer product for first release of PowerPC MAC.
Evaluate project management strategies for improved software development within Apple software.  Work with software teams to implement software engineering principles.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Work with others to design XGL API.  Design internal device driver model for XGL and implement it for GX and ZX products.  Interface with X Windows engineers to develop DGA for client side rendering in SunOS.  Technical lead of ZX port of XGL managing six software engineers.  Work with other graphics engineers to port to XGL interface.
	
	Knowledge Basis
	3D graphics algorithms including various optimizations to the 3D pipeline and 3D texturing.  OpenGL API.  OpenGL ICD model.  NT, W2K, WXP driver internals.  Display driver and miniport development and debugging.  Debugging display driver using WinDbg.  gdb debugging on Linux and OS X.  Some DirectDraw and Direct3D experience.  Working knowledge of C/C++/x86 programming.  PC internals and PC chipsets.  Phoenix and Award SBIOS cores.  Debugging using HDT.  General Windows knowledge.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Computer Vision, Machine Learning, AI, Network Security
